# Deterministic lockstep input script that creates a new save, returns to
# file select, then selects the occupied slot to enter gameplay.
#
# This covers saved-slot gameplay entry, Uncle's first in-room message
# dismissal, repeated indoor movement sweeps, A-button interaction probes,
# and later in-room message trigger/dismissal cycles.
#
# Format: <frame-or-inclusive-range> <buttons>
# Buttons can be combined with +, comma, or |. Accepted names:
# B Y SELECT START UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT A X L R NONE
